decision: Accept the originating spec's four-axis model (operator_surface x agent_runtime x role x execution_locality) as the frame, but reject its literal seven-feature decomposition where it duplicates existing subsystems. agent_runtime (agent_surface.py + executors/AGENT_REGISTRY + KNOWN_OPERATOR_AGENTS) and role (roles CLI + agent register-worker + role_assignment.py) and execution_locality (environments.json + worktree + DispatchTask.cwd) already exist. The only fully-absent axis is operator_surface.
rationale: DontPanic governance avoids parallel/competing registries. The genuinely-new work is the operator_surface axis, detection, a presence ledger, easy role choice, a channel doctor, and a dashboard render.

decision: REVISED per operator critique: operator-role choice is SETTABLE in v0 (F004), not deferred. It is a layer separate from the worker-dispatch ROLES (implementer/auditor/goal_auditor), stored under a distinct operator_roles.* config namespace, with NO assert_registrable guard so non-executor surfaces (e.g. cursor) can be assigned. The existing roles / agent register-worker worker paths are untouched. Easy set/list CLI + dashboard role-matrix projection deliver the 'Claude primary, Codex auditor, Gemini researcher' UX that was the core of the ask.
rationale: The first draft deferred settable operator roles, missing the explicit product requirement (easy role choice). Conflating the two role namespaces would break the executor guard, so they stay separate but both are first-class in v0.

decision: Forbid a new agent-channels.json registry. The channel/role view (F006) is derived at build time from the invocation ledger + executors/AGENT_REGISTRY + capabilities/*.json (incl. the new operator-surface manifests from F005) + worktree bindings + operator_roles. A test asserts no agent-channels.json is introduced.
rationale: A hand-maintained channel registry would drift from the executor registry and capability manifests that already encode the same facts.

decision: REVISED scope: defer ONLY the fully-open adapter marketplace (third-party adapter submission/registry format) and remote-locality enforcement/routing. doctor --channel (F005) and settable operator roles (F004) are pulled INTO v0 per the critique.
rationale: Those two were the practical heart of the ask ('will this work from Cursor/Codex/Antigravity?' and 'make role choice easy'); deferring them left the plan architecturally sound but product-thin. The marketplace and remote enforcement remain genuinely demand-gated.

decision: The presence ledger (F003) must be concurrency- and privacy-hardened: atomic/lock-safe append under multiple simultaneous agents, command-string argument redaction (tokens/secrets in args, beyond field-name checks), no raw home paths (sanitized like audit evidence), and a retention/compaction policy.
rationale: Multiple agents run at once; a naive append corrupts under concurrency, and command strings can carry tokens in arguments. The audit-evidence-writer-hygiene work (PR #48) is the precedent for path/identity sanitization.

decision: execution_locality is a sharp enum (local_mac, plan_worktree, dashboard_terminal, code_task, remote_vm, github_vm, unknown), not a thin local|remote. github_vm added per lock-review to distinguish GitHub Agent HQ / Copilot-VM execution from a generic remote_vm.
rationale: The Cowork-VM-vs-Mac-code-task and GitHub-VM distinctions are the reason the axis exists; local|remote cannot represent worktree vs dashboard-terminal vs code-task vs github-vm localities or drive the remote_cannot_mutate_local conflict semantics.

decision: Operator surfaces/runtimes that are not executors (Cursor, Antigravity, Claude Desktop, Codex app) get capability-manifest shape via a new operator_surface kind in the EXISTING capability schema (F005), with seeded manifests — NOT a new registry. This is what makes 'derive from capabilities' real for surfaces that have no executor.
rationale: The first draft named these surfaces in the enum but derived support only from executors/capabilities, which many surfaces lack. Extending the capability manifest shape closes that gap while honoring the no-new-registry decision.

decision: F006's dashboard conflict/health semantics go beyond same_plan_conflict to include same_branch, same_repo, unhealthy_worktree_binding, remote_cannot_mutate_local, and operator_only_runtime_not_dispatchable, derived by joining the ledger with worktree bindings and agent_surface dispatchability.
rationale: Same-plan conflict alone misses the real collision and health cases operators hit when multiple agents share branches/worktrees or when an operator-only runtime cannot be dispatched.

decision: SAFETY INVARIANT (lock-review): operator_roles.* (F004) are preferences/intent ONLY and are NEVER dispatch authorization. Assigning any surface/agent an operator role -- including a non-executor surface like Cursor as primary_operator -- must never make DontPanic able to spawn it as a worker. Dispatch authority derives SOLELY from executors/AGENT_REGISTRY via the worker roles.* namespace (guarded by assert_registrable). F004 carries an explicit test that a surface holding only an operator-role preference is refused at dispatch exactly as if no role were set.
rationale: The two-namespace separation is the main safety line of this plan: a preference layer that could silently confer dispatch/spawn authority on an arbitrary surface would be a privilege-escalation footgun. Stated as a first-class invariant with a dedicated test so it cannot regress.

decision: Lock-review single-surface recut: the original three multi-surface features (operator-role F004 = CLI mutation + dashboard render + dispatch safety; channel doctor F005 = CLI + capability schema; dashboard panel F006 = engine producer + JS logic + render) are split into a ten-feature set F001-F010 so each feature touches one primary surface. Mapping: F004->F004 (operator-role config CLI), F004->F005 (dashboard role-matrix projection), F004->F006 (dispatch-safety guard / D009 invariant); F005->F007 (channel doctor CLI), F005->F008 (operator-surface capability-manifest schema); F006->F009 (channel-view producer + JS logic), F006->F010 (dashboard Operator Channels panel). Renumbered sequentially (not F004a/b) because the features schema id pattern is ^F[0-9]{3}$ and rejects letter suffixes. No acceptance content was dropped; every original AC is distributed verbatim across the children.
rationale: plan-review flagged over_surface / likely_timeout on F004/F005/F006: features spanning CLI mutation, dashboard rendering, and orchestration-safety semantics are hard to test, hard to audit, and easy to partially satisfy. Operator directed splitting before spending the paid pre_impl sufficiency call rather than overriding the design gate, since the linter correctly identified real scope-shape risk (distinct from the introduced-by-plan missing_prereq symbol noise, which is override-eligible).

decision: Pre-impl sufficiency round 1 (paid, post auditor-hardening) returned 10 blocking findings; resolved by tightening the plan (no code, no re-lock). Determinism pins: F002 deterministic locality rule table with a named cell per ExecutionLocality member + unrecognized-explicit-value->unknown_* ; F003 dual path representation + abnormal-exit exactly-one-record + compaction-preserves-classification-fields ; F004 global-vs-project precedence + provenance + CLI scope shape ; F008 standard probe vocabulary + minimum probe set ; F009/F010 a single LOCKED bucket rule matrix (active/stale threshold, conflict precedence, same_repo-vs-same_branch overlap, active-only conflicts). THREE EXPLICIT DESIGN CALLS (operator defaults): (1) NAMING/ALIAS CONTRACT — canonical ids are lowercase snake/kebab-stable; display labels are aliases only; normalize_identifier maps user inputs (e.g. 'Claude Code'/'claude-cli'/'Anthropic Claude' -> claude) and unknowns -> unknown_* (never invented). Canonical sets: operator_surface = terminal, codex_app, claude_desktop, claude_dispatch, antigravity, cursor, github_agent_hq, remote_vm, github_vm, unknown_surface; agent_runtime = claude, codex, gemini, grok, cursor, antigravity, opencode, aider, unknown_runtime; execution_locality = local_mac, plan_worktree, dashboard_terminal, code_task, remote_vm, github_vm, unknown_locality. (2) F008 SEEDS exactly the four named app/operator surfaces cursor, claude_desktop, codex_app, antigravity; Gemini/Grok stay runtimes, not surfaces. (3) SANITIZED PATH = store BOTH path_display (home-scrubbed UI/evidence string) AND path_key (stable non-secret canonical key/hash for equality/conflict); never use the scrubbed display as the equality key.
rationale: Round-1 findings were predominantly determinism rule-pins plus three genuine design choices the operator settled with defaults. Capturing the whole shape now (free) before the next paid re-lock keeps the sufficiency call pointed at a clean plan and avoids slot-machine re-locks. The naming/alias contract is the integration backbone the easy-role-choice + prove-a-surface journeys depend on.

decision: Pre-impl sufficiency round 2 returned 8 findings (4 high + 4 medium); resolved by tightening the contract (no code, no re-lock) per operator decisions. (1) Add 'auditor' to OPERATOR_ROLES (F004) as operator INTENT only, never worker-dispatch authority (D009/F006). (2) Operator-role VALUE DOMAIN (F004) = union of { agent_runtime ids (claude/codex/gemini/grok/...), operator_surface ids (cursor/antigravity/codex_app/claude_desktop/...), the literal 'human', and 'unknown_role' }, all normalized through the F001 canonical alias table; unrecognized -> unknown_role. (3) F002 pins a named per-surface detection cell for EACH seeded operator_surface (cursor, codex_app, claude_desktop, antigravity), not only a generic TERM_PROGRAM fallback, plus the DONT_PANIC_AGENT-unrecognized -> unknown_runtime test path. (4) F009 source list FIXED: dispatchability is sourced from AGENT_REGISTRY, which is now explicit in the enumerated derive-only-from set {ledger, capabilities (incl. operator-surface manifests), worktree bindings, operator_roles, AGENT_REGISTRY} -- resolving the 'derived only from [4]' vs 'capabilities + AGENT_REGISTRY' contradiction. (5) 'unknown_role' is an explicit canonical member of the role axis (F001) and the value-domain fallback (F004). (6) F007 doctor returns three outcomes: recognized+seeded -> per-check pass/warn/fail; recognized-but-unseeded -> advisory 'recognized_unseeded' (a known channel, not yet manifested), NOT pretend-unsupported; normalizes-to-unknown_surface -> non-zero. (7) F009 LOCKED RULE MATRIX completed with a deterministic criterion + precedence for remote_only, remote_cannot_mutate_local, unhealthy_worktree_binding, and operator_only_runtime_not_dispatchable (not just stale/conflict).
rationale: Round-2 highs were not override-ready: two clean plan misses (auditor role; F009 source-of-truth contradiction) plus two core-semantics gaps (operator-role value domain; per-surface deterministic detection). Operator directed fixing them in the contract before implementation. Captured the whole shape now (free) before any further paid re-lock. The hardened auditor (PR #53, now on main) validated itself live this round by remapping two gap_class='matrix_pin' findings instead of discarding the paid response.
